description: Defines the ServerThread class for running a QuicServer in a dedicated thread, including methods for control and synchronization.

classes.name: ServerThread
classes.description: A wrapper class to run QuicServer in a dedicated thread with control methods.

methods.name: ServerThread
methods.description: Constructor initializing ServerThread with a QuicServer instance and address.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Prepares the server without starting to accept connections.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the event loop for the server.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules an action to be executed in the server's event loop.

methods.name: WaitForCryptoHandshakeConfirmed
methods.description: Waits until the first crypto handshake is confirmed.

methods.name: WaitUntil
methods.description: Waits until a predicate returns true or timeout occurs.

methods.name: Quit
methods.description: Stops the server and shuts it down.

methods.name: server
methods.description: Returns pointer to the underlying QuicServer.

methods.name: GetPort
methods.description: Returns the port number the server is listening on.

methods.name: MaybeNotifyOfHandshakeConfirmation
methods.description: Internal method to notify handshake confirmation.

methods.name: ExecuteScheduledActions
methods.description: Internal method to execute scheduled actions.
